craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 53. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: By brahmin-killing and the rest, by sins and by association with them minor sins: then of him not to be done, initiation in this unperformed rite.
l4.sanskrit_cite: brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaistatsaṅgaiścopapātakaiḥ tadā tasya na kartavyā dīkṣāsminnakṛte vidhau
